long_biography.plain_text:
Heikki Luoma works in yacht and ship brokerage through Compass International, whose business extends from vessel sales to newbuilding and conversion enquiries. The firm handles sailing and motor yachts alongside tugs, survey ships and oceanographic vessels, bringing leisure craft and specialised commercial ships within the same brokerage practice.

Compass markets vessels on behalf of their sellers through hundreds of corresponding brokers, regularly circulating central-agency brochures and contacting buyers on its own client list directly. For complex transactions, the brokerage draws on maritime lawyers and consultants to assist the sale or purchase.
